message: Proposed a 1 kΩ / 100 nF RC low-pass filter with a calculated corner of about 1.59 kHz.

proposal.title: 1.6 kHz RC low-pass filter
proposal.summary: A 1 V AC sine source drives a series resistor, with a capacitor from the output to ground. The high-impedance load is represented by leaving the output unloaded.
assumptions: The source has zero output impedance.
The load impedance is high enough to have negligible effect on the filter.
The source frequency property is set to 1 kHz for completeness; AC analysis sweeps frequency using acmag.

parts.role: Provides the 1 V sine input and a 1 V small-signal AC stimulus.
Series element of the low-pass filter.
Shunts high-frequency signal energy to ground; with R1 it sets the corner near 1.59 kHz.

simulations.description: Verify the low-frequency gain and approximately 1.6 kHz corner frequency.

expectations.description: At 100 Hz, the output should be close to unity gain because it is well below the corner.
The -3 dB corner should be close to the calculated 1.59 kHz value.
